title: Trump–Xi summit (Washington) — trade, export-control, AI-governance agenda
source: NEWS: Atlantic Council/CSIS Trump-Xi 2026 Summit coverage + techtimes semiconductor-tariff reporting, checked 2026-08-28. STRENGTHENED 2026-09-23: both governments' own primary channels now carry the visit — whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements (First Lady's office, 2026-09-21, verbatim 'to the White House on Thursday, September 24, 2026, for an official state visit') and China's Foreign Ministry (fmprc.gov.cn, Guo Jiakun press conference, 2026-09-21, 'President Xi Jinping will soon pay a state visit to the United States'). Status HELD at estimate for a SCHEMA reason, not date doubt: scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs's CONFIRMED_PREFIX has no slot for a White House or Chinese-government source (same gap us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10.json recorded first for a WH source alone) — do not spend a future session re-trying this flip without a taxonomy change.
notes: Second in-person Trump-Xi meeting of 2026 (after the May Beijing visit); reported agenda includes AI governance, export controls, and the trade architecture after the Kuala Lumpur truce's Nov-10 tariff-suspension deadline. China semiconductor Section 301 tariffs already run near 70% combined exposure, with a further ~7.5% overcapacity layer reportedly being prepared ahead of the summit — surfaced via AVGO's 2026-08-28 pulse-check adjacency sweep (export-control/supply-chain exposure); most sensitive semis names (AVGO, NVDA, MRVL, AMD) carry it as sector risk, not an AVGO-only event.
